changes.summary: The Solicitor General filed a certiorari petition seeking review of an injunction that preserves five nonprofits' grants; the Court has not agreed to hear the case and disputed funds remain administratively stayed.
Hegseth presided over the Bogotá handover of aircraft FAC 1019 and transfer documents were signed; the sources did not establish the donation's valuation, funding authority or operational use.
OFAC designated three people and two companies tied to scam compounds and armed-group protection networks, immediately applying U.S. blocking and transaction prohibitions.
OFAC designated the two transnational organizations and additional leaders, facilitators and businesses, while issuing a limited wind-down license through December 18.
The three leaders committed to dialogue on nuclear risk and several broad policy goals but announced no arsenal reductions, treaty or implementation timetable.

Reuters reported the Commission adopted restrictions covering China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom and other IP-enabled providers; the final adopted text and effective date were not yet available in the inspected official sources.
Recorded Greenland's November 3 approval and Denmark's November 19 unanimous consent while preserving the still-pending diplomatic-notification and implementation stages.

evidence_extracts.climate_united: Supreme Court docket 26-589 records a November 2 certiorari petition; review has not been granted and responses are due December 15.
evidence_extracts.colombia_c130: AP and Colombian reporting confirm delivery of donated C-130 FAC 1019 and signed transfer documents.
evidence_extracts.treasury_sanctions: Treasury and OFAC identify implemented blocking actions, named targets, authorities and a bounded wind-down license.
evidence_extracts.trilateral_declaration: The White House text contains four broad commitments but no arms-control limits, verification or implementation deadlines.
evidence_extracts.greenland: Both parliaments approved; formal Danish notification remains the stated step that completes ratification and makes the agreement binding.
evidence_extracts.fcc: Reuters reports the Commission vote; the inspected official record confirms the meeting but did not yet expose the final adopted order or effective date.
